items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: You know, some do; organists like David Selby.

ctx.x: I see. Because I always wondered how hard that was to learn, to play with the feet.

Well, yeah. Well, they don't play with their feet. They just use strategic notes, you know, where they can rest on the pedal. You know, some do; organists like David Selby. You know, he's not a Jazz player, but he's a regular organist, and he uses the heel-and-toe method.
Well, did you use your feet on the pedal?
